name: Long Beach Commission on Youth and Children (youth seats)
org: City of Long Beach Parks, Recreation and Marine
what_you_do: Two youth members join seven adults to advise the Mayor and City Council. They give advice on city services for kids and teens. They also review the city's youth plan.
who_can_apply: Two seats are for youth under 19 at the time of appointment. Each youth is picked by their district councilmember and appointed by the Mayor.
duration: 2-year terms (up to 4 terms); meets every other 3rd Wednesday at 6 p.m.
how_to_apply: The page has no application. Ask your district councilmember's office or the city contacts listed on the page.
notes: Only two youth seats exist. Meeting location was listed as to be decided. Contacts on the page include ashleigh.griset@longbeach.gov and erika.Medrano@longbeach.gov.
